description: Synthetic validation set. The corpus is fictional and self-contained so retrieval quality can be measured deterministically in CI with no API keys. Distractors are deliberately written to share vocabulary with the questions; three of them state their own irrelevance, which is the failure mode a bi-encoder cannot see and a cross-encoder can.

queries.question: How did the intruder get into the facility?
Where did the goods go after they left the building?
What did the offender do to avoid being detected?
Was any demand for payment made after the loss?
Which security systems failed on the night of the incident?
